title: Rabbi Zeira bar Mamal

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Kiddushin 9a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.9a.7-8), raising a difficulty against the baraita; Rava resolves it.[^1]

notes.text: The linked text gives Rabbi Zeira bar Memel’s objection and Rava’s answer in consecutive paragraphs. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1120&lang=en) cites the same passage and raises a separate question about the name in another occurrence. Hyman’s spelling Mamal is retained here.
